1.description: Number One as a standalone number in name numerology isn't very auspicious (though it would be very rare instance to find a person having a name as Mr / Ms A). The progress chart for such a person would slope downward. Beginnings would be good but will not be able to achieve the end results due to issues such as confusions, unnecessary complications, ego hassles and inflexibility. The number (as in the name) does not have qualities that lead to success, so in short, an unfavorable number for name. Though this number can be used as house number or car number.
1.businessDescription: This number can be avoided as a business name as the support of sun can be sought using other numbers.

2.description: Number ruled by moon itself confirms the fickle mindedness, indecisiveness, excessive emotions, fear, anxiety etc. These people lack self -confidence an always fearful and anxious. They are highly imaginative people usually far from reality. They fail to find a balance in life which l eads to their failure. Such people can also be easily manipulated and can be very easily dominated. They lack opinions. The only good quality of such people is they are adaptable. But again, a person is having name number as 2 would be rare incidence.
2.businessDescription: A weak name number to have as business needs a backbone to stand. A planet like moon alone is weak to provide that support.

3.description: Number 3 as a name number is progressive. These people have the ability to scale heights owing to their sharp intellect, strong academic, high spiritual values and communicative nature. Number 3 people can be great scholars or people holding high degrees. They have a good name in society and are looked up to for advice and can make for good counsellors. This number has all round impact on the person bestowing him with good family life, excellent work environment and acceptability in society.
3.businessDescription: This can be used as a business name as it has the blessing of Guru. If the owner's mind and body number are compatible with the business would scale height.

4.description: Those with number 4 are usually bogged down by the influence of others in their life, be it family or friends. They usually have to subject themselves to the authority and control of others and due to this they don't raise much in life and work in subordination. Rahu is head without the body so lot of mindless thinking happens so chances of psychological disorders cannot be ruled out. All their talents are underutilized and efforts put in also don't yield the desired result. They should practice caution while interacting or it can their already little social circle that they have.
4.businessDescription: Only a business which involves gambling, speculation and casinos can use this as a business name. For the rest it is a complete no.

5.description: Innovative, disciplined, hardworking, calculative, honest, liked by all, creative and communicative are a few traits possessed by name number 5 people. They are good number crunchers. They enjoy success both in academics and career' They have the ability to garner a lot of fame and name. Interest in arts especially performing arts can be anot her feather in their cap. They have a lot of self -confidence, extremely talented and have the ability to make a lot of money. They strike a perfect balance between the physical and the spiritual world.
5.businessDescription: This number ensures success in business. Such a business would bring out new and novel products in the market. Business has good earnings.

6.description: These are the people who enjoy peace and happiness and usually are surrounded by a lot of friends. Their life is full of comforts and these people are lovers of luxury. Having an artistic bent of mind, they like creating and also collecting things having exclusivity. Things come to them slowly but are steady. Love is what they seek. Relationships carry a lot of importance in their life. Friends are of great help to these people.
6.businessDescription: Name number 6 would make the business very prosperous. Business wo uld earn handsome profits.

7.description: Name number 7 have divine blessings working in their life. These people are seekers of deeper meaning in life. They have the ability to rise above the worldly matters easily and focus on matters which have real in meaning life, the spiritual matters. They find most of their answers within and therefore believe in less interaction. All these qualities can make them good counsellors and astrologers. Family life for them might be a little disoriented. They rise above emotions and desires and are able to see things clearly.
7.businessDescription: This number is not associated with material and business just run for profit which makes this number a complete avoids.

8.description: Name number 8 denotes a life full of hardships. Lots of efforts are required for these people to succeed in life. There is a lot of slogging required to be done to achieve results and result usually come in later stages of life. It is a good number for people who seek mocha. They tend to give up on family life. They are prone to accidents, dangers and uncalled for situations. Sacrifice takes the centre stage in their life on all the fronts. Spirituality would add meaning to their life. The y possess some administrative skills which can help them in their work area. In short, it is a very destructive number to have been no less than a living hell.
8.businessDescription: A business with name number 8 will encounter lockouts, labor unrest, labor scarcity, strikes or other situations beyond control. It is advisable to avoid it completely.

9.description: Since the number is dominated by Mars so such people are action oriented, always on the go. Aggression in whatsoever they do is prominent. The only motto in the life is to achieve success that is what makes them so full of life. They have the power to overcome any kind of adversity. Courageous, intolerant, argumentative, harsh and determined are what makes up such people. Sooner or later, they achieve success in life owing to their 'never say die' spirit. They live a comfortable and prosperous life.
9.businessDescription: A business engaged in manufacturing things related to fire or security can use this as the name number, provided the name number is compatible with the mind body number.

10.description: This name number is much better than the name number one, being followed by zero. Their life is like a revolving wheel, with its share of ups and downs but every time they hit their low, they are able to organize the resources and the means, to get back on track in order to keep the momentum going. There is no shortage of funds in their life and thus life a dignified & happy life. Such a name number c an be either famous or notorious (famous in bad sense), according to the desires and actions of the person concerned a project through or meeting deadlines.
10.businessDescription: In case of a business enterprise, it would indicate financial gains and all -round expansion. It is a very favorable number for government organizations being ruled by Sun. Conducting business, having 10 as name number, without corruption would take it to heights.

11.description: For a name number 11, it is imperative to have faith in God which would help them sail through life. Such people will be let down by near & dear ones and are therefore required not to depend on them or there would be high chances of betrayal.
11.businessDescription: Such people can be very successful in areas such as interior decoration, chemicals, petroleum, arts and publicity.

12.description: Such people have the power to influence masses due to gift of oratory skills to them. Their speech is so powerful that people are automatically drawn towards them. They do a lot for the welfare and happiness of people, eve n to the extent of sacrificing their lives. Their heart goes out to the underprivileged and would have the ability to fight for their rights. Success would come by only in the later years of life. The number does not have any influence on career or education in any way. Such people are the one who sacrifice their life for others. An example name number 12 was of Diana, princess of Wales.
12.businessDescription: This number gives mixed results when it comes to business, early success might be there due to Sun's hard w ork but Moon will bring in its ups and downs.

13.description: Considered a very inauspicious number to have as a name number. Unexpected and unknown events of sorrowful nature are one of the characteristics of their life. Men having a name number as 13 earn ill repute and are of bad character. They are easily attracted to woman and face a lot of difficulties because of woman. They are able to rise materially but will have a miserable life full of struggles and difficulties. Number 13 is also a number for transformation and spiritualism. This number opens the way for people who want to advance spiritually.
13.businessDescription: History of the world confirms the days months associated with number 13 have faced the most destructive events. Hotels usually do not have floor or rooms with the same number. Business houses are also not advised to use name number as 13. A good number for people involves in research related work, occult sciences and religious works.

14.description: Those having name number 14 are always surrounded by a lot of people. They do really well in the field of ma ss communication and politics. People listen very attentively to whatever they have to say, in way they know how to keep the interest of listeners alive. Their career graph slopes upwards, rising with their advancing age. They have speculative tendencies a nd are rewarded there as well. Prosperity, luck and support from others will flow throughout their lives. They tend to get extremely confident and over ambitious which should not be the case. They are calculative risk takers. They should be careful in love affairs. Overall, a good number to have as a name number.
14.businessDescription: They do well in most of the businesses. It does well for businesses involving communication with the masses (public speaking, writing, publishing), businesses of speculative nature, travel related businesses, politics. If the product being dealt in also has the same name number (14). Success is guaranteed.

15.description: - Mercury This is a very good number to have for material success. These people have the quest to succeed and earn money. These people are usually charming and know how to put their point forward. People associated with this number would do really well in the field of arts. They enjoy all comforts of life and enjoy full support of friends & family. Such people hold power over and above others and they would go to any limit to achieve what they desire (also through undesirable means). If the birth number is also favourable such people will achieve wealth, fame and distinction in all areas of life.
15.businessDescription: A good number for success, especially in areas of arts and science. These people can do well in politics as well.

16.description: A destructive number to have as a name number. The steeper their rise, the fall is equally steeper. Even an ordinary person rises to the zenith of their career but is suddenly pushed into depths of valley. They fall can be from a position, office, grace or power. Unexpected catastrophic event is associated with this number. King today, pauper tomorrow is what sums up this number. This number is associated with accidents, disappointments (more so on love & marriage front) and some fatal incident. They will have devilish thoughts different from how the world thinks. They are likely to cause a lot of harm to the society with their thinking pattern. A person having a name number 16 should be advised to change it with immediate effect. This n umber should be specifically avoided by women as it would give them problems related to child birth or uterus or ovaries issue.
16.businessDescription: This number is equally destructive for businesses because it is associated with gigantic rise and even more gigantic fall. Not recommend for business. Example - Nokia.

17.description: Life for such a person is full of trials & tribulations but the good part of such a number is once a person persistently tries & makes his way through the struggle there is no stopping the person's rise to fame and glory. Such prosperity achieved by the person is permanent. The key point to note here the struggle is continuous & if the person does not give up, only then the name number would act and show its results. They are strong people and tireless workers; they also have the strength to defeat their opposition. They are able to make a place for themselves in people's heart and are proud of their achievements.
17.businessDescription: This number repr esents intuition, expression and beauty. A good number for astrologers, poet, musicians and artists.

18.description: Force at work. This number makes a person quarrelsome and in case a country has 18 as the name, there would be war or social upheaval. This number is devoid of divinity, will bring in troubles, dangerous foes and devious thinking. They take the evil path and prove to an anti-social element for the society. Their personal ambition takes so much weight age in their life that they forget their morals. They indulge in vices like women, drinking and gambling. They face threats from unknown enemies, sharp weapons and even bombs.
18.businessDescription: Not a good name number to have for business with so much negativity around it. Examples of states in India having 18 as name number Kashmir and now Mumbai (earlier Bombay).

19.description: This is one of the most favorable numbers indicating successful completion of a task. With the dual influence of sun on the number success is the declaration of this number. Since this number starts with the first number and ends with the last number in the number series, they prosper gradually in life. As they age, they become famous and wealthy. They will amass huge wealth. They look younger than their age and are physically strong. They are honest, enjoy good health & will have a good life partner and good social standing. They aim to continuo usly strive in life to achieve their goals. They have charismatic personality and can do well in politics. Example - Mayawati.
19.businessDescription: A good number that can be used by business establishments. The rise would be by leaps & bounds & would generate a lot of name & fame, provided no treachery is practiced in the business dealings. Example — Subway and City Bank.

20.description: Those having name number 20 are calmand peaceful. These people have a very powerful imagination, are sympathetic and would go to any extent to help the needy. In short, they can term as 'divine soul' sent for this particular purpose (of awakening the society). This isn't a material number so success on the worldly front isn't there. If such people are selfish, they will put themselves and people all around them into trouble. If such a person takes the spiritual path, life runs very smoothly. Delays and obstacles can be one of the characteristics associated with these people but that can overcome by practicing meditation.
20.businessDescription: This number is good for religious organizations and meditation centers.

21.description: planets Sun These people are excessively self - centered and are only concerned with matters profitable to them. With great determination these people have the ability to rise in life and scale new heights. Initial days of life involve a lot of struggles but victory and achievements follow in the later part of life. Their tactful nature helps them sail through many a life's problems. Their success would not go unnoticed. They would be bestowed with wealth, name and fame. Their rise to glory is attributed to their hard work. They will achieve and retain high positions permanently in their lives. Example — Mary Kom and A R Rahman.
21.businessDescription: A good number to have for business establishments. Example — Yahoo and Walmart.

22.description: In number 22 there is high level of moon energy & people these days have a weak aura (magnetic field around them) so they are unable to absorb the high energy generated by moon so that cause disruption in the brain waves and affects mental peace and happiness. These people are more govern ed by evil than good i.e., it is the evil that draws their mind. In the early part of the life, his interests would be compromised by others. In the later stages, the person will get into evil ways by the turn of events played by destiny & even if he would try to forsake evil ways, he would be led on my family and friends. They would earn more money through devious ways like gambling, betting on horses etc. People around them look for chances to betray them. They are shrewd and successful. They face the dif ficulties life throws at them bravely. They live their life in extravaganza.
22.businessDescription: Number 22 is good for non - living entities. They can make a fortune if involved in businesses such as the one involving manpower & machinery like publishing, cinemas , hotels, gambling, casinos and construction works. Any business involving masses can be practiced by these people.

23.description: - Jupiter The number has the beneficial association of Moon and Jupiter which enables them to succeed in life. They will be recognized for their talent and appreciated. All the plans conceived with a noble mind will meet their desired ends. They can achieve ends eve n beyond their imagination. Their accomplishments will be talked about. They cannot be deviated from their track and have the ability to win over competition. Anything they do will be successful and will enjoy a royal status. Friends would be of great help and many. They need to strive hard to be lucky. These people are required to get into bigger tasks for a successful life, monotonous or odd jobs would make these people lazy. They are the most sorts after people in government -as well as private enterpris es. Those who don't strive hard waste their time in day — dreaming. Example — Maithili Raj, Kiran Bedi and Ratan Tata.
23.businessDescription: An excellent number for business establishments. It goes well with most of the mind and body number. The number promises suc cess Example - Boeing.

24.description: Those with number 24 would hold a very high position in government or will receive a lot of favours from government. They can gain a lot by their associations with th e opposite sex. They will be lucky in love. The person they get married to, will have a higher social status and would be wealthier than them. They rise very swiftly from their ranks or position, even if they start at lower ranks or small set up their prog ress is very fast. They live a royal life and enjoy fame. They will progress with each passing day. They focus a lot on enhancing their outer beauty so they believe in expending their resources on beauty products, apparel and jewellery. They possess huge w ealth. They lead a disciplined life. Example — Amit Shah and Anil Ambani. For business A business involving dealing with the opposite gender would see phenomenal growth under such a name number. Name number 24 people progress very fast in uniformed service.

25.description: Mercury This is a good number to have because it promises results in the end. The person would face struggle on professional as well as personal front. Success for them comes only after they have gone through struggle which gives them strength to endure and keep moving, self - confidence, spiritual advancement, occult wisdomand support of those around. These people have good intuitive powers. They lead a much -disciplined life establishing standards for themselves which they adhere to at any cost. Their writing and speech are powerful. Public support is certain in their life. The lives of these people will end with honor and respect though their personal life suffers. Example —Tina Ambani, Bill Gates, Rajat Sharma and Nita Ambani.
25.businessDescription: Not a good number for business as there would be hurdles on the path to growth. The business will not have a good name in the market. Example - Nestle.

26.description: This number denotes debts in the old age. This number is a grave warning for the future. They spend lavishly even beyond their means. Friends are of no good to such people. Caution should be practiced by such an individual while making investments and should not depend on advice of others. Such people should stay away from speculation, partnerships and bad company. They face unending confusion in their mind. If at all they take up wrong means to accomplish a task they are bound to fail. They would do anything for the sake of money. In spite of having noble ideas, success would still be a distant dream for them. It is the number of hidden enemies and endless controversies. Example — Imran Khan.
26.businessDescription: It is an unlucky business name. Business will take up projects but it does not have the capacity to handle and will not be able to meet deadlines thus fail. Example — Coal India.

27.description: The most fortunate souls are the ones which highest wisdomand full of knowledge. They do not look for love outside because they find everything within such are the traits on number 27 people. This number promises command, authority, fame and power. This number signifies relentless, hard work, clear mind & intelligence, accumulation of wealth, all around prosperity and position of high stature. Persons with such a number should carry out their tasks independently. This number is as fortunate as number 24, good for people in uniform. They like to do things for the society. They have the ability to make huge profits due to their hard work. They get involved in holy activities and can easily master the art of meditation, hypnotism, knowledge of magic, astral travel and telepathy. Example — Govinda, Jackie Chan and Kamal Hassan.
27.businessDescription: It is a very favourable number for business, It guarantees success & profits to most of the mind and body numbers.

28.description: Such people face a lot of hardships in life. They may have to start their lives over and over again due to unprecedented events that they face. It denotes an individual with caliber who is likely to see everything taken away due to a rash decision. This nu mber indicates loss through trust in others, competition, non - compliance with the legal aspects and opposition. They progress in undoubtedly fast but are followed by losses. Money lent by such people doesn't come back. It is advised to such people to mak e a change in their name to avoid the suffering.
28.businessDescription: Not a good number for trade as well. The influence of moon and Saturn is extremely dangerous which can destroy even a well -established business in a flash of a second. Whatever business has a na me number 28 will ultimately have to bite the dust.

29.description: Mars Such a number is gives deceitful friends, unreliable partner and treachery at the hands of the opposite sex. They get involved in litigation to settle their disputes. They will be le t down by family and friends. They may face suffering due to the opposite sex. These people live an unhappy life with their partner, a life full of agony and disappointments. Personal front suffers great deal. They have suicidal instincts and can commit su icide due to oppression by the opposite sex. Unless the name number is corrected properly, these people would keep facing such issues throughout their lives.
29.businessDescription: The two number involved are opposite to each other. The situation within the business would be the reason for the trouble. The business would be internally weak and so such a number must be avoided as business name number.

30.description: Number 30 people have a lot of disciplines sense, diplomacy and cunning aspect of Jupiter. A true humanitarian is how we can best describe number 30. Living in a materialistic world people has less desire to have name number 30. These people possess a lot of mental discipline; they know their mind and know how to conquer it easily. They gain mystical powers through the art of controlling and mental exercises. They have a highly imaginative mind. They are well endowed with the power of thinking. They would jump into a difficult task if their mind so guides, even if the project / thing does not hold a promise for any gains. They do not have much interest in making money. They succeed in everything they undertake and do not believe in compromising. Example — Salman Khan, Kapil Dev.
30.businessDescription: Number associated with surgery, medic ine, chemistry, beneficial in theatre and script writing. They are motivational speakers for a religious or NGO like institutions.

31.description: Jupiter Sun People having the name number 31 act according to their own mind and do not believe in taking other's opinion. They do not care about facing profits/losses, they only wish to take up what their mind desires. Success follows them in whatever tasks they take up. They have interests in astrology, yoga, medicine, spiritualism, and gaining knowledge of the Vedas or anything that involves deep research. These people may even forgo their profits for mental peace. Their whole life will be aimless and will take things as they come; they are not driven by profits so it isn't a very good numbers for material gains. Some of them would even give up family life to become sanyasis. As they grow older, they become intuitive and sense their death well in advance. Example — Rakhi Sawant.
31.businessDescription: This number is good for spiritual pursuits but when it comes to materials gains this number would be of no help. No worldly enjoyments or success are associated with 31.

32.description: This number has the ability to attract masses & will have excessive name and f ame. They would have a captivating speech in short, they have the ability to sway the masses. This number has vibrations of making a person a prominent personality. Living life on their terms would never lead to failure in life but following someone else's ideas will lead to failure in their case. They have the ability to propagate new ideas and concepts. They have a sharp intellect and a charismatic personality, since 3 is followed by 2 (decreasing order, these people would face ups and downs in life. They will attain high positions in life and will remain youthful in appearance even when they age. Example — Virat Kohli and Anil Kumble.
32.businessDescription: An average number to have. These numbers can only be used if & only if it is compatible with the mind and bod y number. Independently name number 32 isn't capable of giving results.

33.description: planet/s Jupiter This is a very special number in numerology. It is a very constructive and unique number in many ways. This number signifies spiritual growth along with material growth. These people are blessed to achieve spiritual enlightenment automatically without much of an effort and along with it are blessed with material prosperity. The presence of Jupiter and qualities in the form of 30 and 3 to form Venus 6 is a perfect flow of energy from yin to yang. Woman unable to conceive should be advised to use 33 as the name number to produce healthy off - springs. These people have luck going for them so a really good number to have as a name number. Example — Bipasha Basu.
33.businessDescription: A good name number to have as far as business success is concerned. Business will never face any shortage of funds or wise work force to conduct its operations. When these two pillars are in place, the business will keep generating profits. Example - Unilever.

34.description: This name number makes people prone to addictions like women and alcohol. They will have a disturbed family life. Confusions and discord will prevail on the domestic front. Their mind fails to resist to sexual pleasures in other words they are addicted to sex. Material prosperity isn't a problem. They make a lot of money that too from various sources. These people have the knack for displaying their qualities in an attractive manner. They spend a lot of money on vices. They aren't liked by people but they still will have a social standing owning to the wealth they amass. Example - Yuvraj Singh.
34.businessDescription: Unlike individual name number. For business a number li ke 34 would do well because it promises material gains rather easily. Example - Mc Donalds.

35.description: Number 35 has the ability to bestow the person with all kind riches and also the ability to snatch it all away in one goes. These people would appear to the society as one's having all luxuries of life but in reality, will have lot of debts to settle. They face the risk of their fortunes changing overnight. They are prone to accidents, legal issues, gettin g drawn towards illegal ways of making money, drinking. Friends and family will be of little or no help at all. The desire to earn money is so strong that they would go to any extent to earn money. Physical ailments like paralysis, stomach related issues o r nervous system complaints can also face. Example - Dinesh Kartik.
35.businessDescription: associated with the name number are more than the profit potential associated with it.

36.description: These people achieve a lot of success through hard work. They can make a fortune if they use their talents well. It is imperative for such people to move away from their home town to achieve success. Those who do not move out of their native place don't have luck by their side. These people have the ability to rise from bottom to the top and enjoy a life of riches. They enjoy good positions and travel extensively. Family life for such people is not great, there are lot of confusions in the family. Example — Rahul Gandhi, Sonia Gandhi and Arnab Goswami.
36.businessDescription: Name number can only be adopted for business if the mind number is 9. Else this number associates itself with wrong decisions and losses.

37.description: Number 37 gives great power 7 appeals to an individual. It is one of the lucky numbers to have as name number. It can raise an ordinary person to an extraordinary level. These people tend to gain in professional & personal life through associations with the opposite sex i.e., men benefitted by women and women benefitted by men. They lead a comfortable & prosperous life & have the company of good & reliable friends of both the genders and are lucky in love. They will dress up attractively, have pleasing personality and mannerism they have enthusiasm & charisma and usually the centre of attraction in large groups. This number should be used by ordinary people to rise up in life because if used by people of high positions it will only give them problems as when greed comes up the power given by the number will lose its importance. Example - Anil kapoor, Paresh Rawal and Daler Mehndi.
37.businessDescription: Highly successful number when it comes to business. The business becomes so attractive that corporate, private equity firms, foreign institutional investor would want to buy a share in it. Example - Tata Motors.

38.description: Some characteristics to describe name number 38 people are honest, peace lovers, spiritually inclined, great integrity, gentle and innocent. This name number can bring in a lot of success with the help of influential 7 wealthy people in their circle. Such people progress to fame easily even if they make small beginnings. They grow step by step in life and achieve great status in society. Despite the favourable aspects of this number these people suffer due to unexpected dangers, unknown enemies that can crop up any time. The end o f their life is miserable is usually mysterious and unexpected. There can be shocking & uncalled for experiences towards the end of the life and also will be cheated by people. Example — Narendra Modi and Madhuri Dixit.
38.businessDescription: A business is a never -ending entity. A proprietorship passes it from generation to generation and company from has a perpetual seal which keeps its operations going. A number like 38 has disastrous end or unexpected end, so if the business ceases to exit this number cannot be suitable for any sort of business.

39.description: These people are sincere, hardworking and people of high intellect. They unceasingly work for the welfare for others and keep the welfare of others above themselves. Even the credit, name and fame due to them because of their hard work are enjoyed by others. They can work nonstop & would do anything for friends and family. They have connections abroad which help them carry out their business smoothly. They enjoy pleasu res in the later part of life as that part of life is hassle free. They are not as healthy as other number 3 people. They are prone to skin related disorders. Example — Anushka Sharma, Ekta Kapoor, Piyush Goyal and Mukesh Ambani.
39.businessDescription: Average name number for business, as this business will not be able to enjoy as much name and profits in the market as are due to them. It is drainage of effort. Particular care has to be taken that people will driver no. 6 should not keep this as a business name as Jupiter and Venus are opposite to each other.

40.description: These people possess a lot of intelligence & achieve success in literary work and business. They have a lot of dependable friends who help them rise and achieve good positions in life. They amass huge wealth within in a short time. This is the name which p romises success, name and fame. They have talent to drive a task to completion. They have good oratory and writing skills. These people can go to any extent to achieve their goals, even taking an unlawful route taking harsh steps. Eventually they will lose all of their money and their life will turn out to be fruitless They may have of suffer in isolation and will be totally neglected. Example - Harshad Mehta.
40.businessDescription: A number promising success in very short time and will even invite jealousy from a l ot of people but good for material success. Example — Ganesh speaks.

41.description: They have great controlling power and an impressive speech. They can become respected leaders and followed by several. They enjoy undiminished fame all their life. Achievers and people of high values are what describe them best. They accomplish matters beyond their capabilities. Any failures that they face on account of such risk bearing nature doesn't come to light, their success does most of talking. They enjoy international fame. Such people need to keep their ego in control or it can play spoilsport in their success. They need to walk the success journey very cautiously and not let success get into their head or it will destroy them. The number is such high intensity that these people can have concerns related to the nervous system. Example - Subroto Roy.
41.businessDescription: No. 4 gives knowledge in various fields, UNO, 1 gives business sense. How can this combination ever fail in giving success? A green signal to this one.

42.description: One of the most powerful numbers falling under the ambit of Venus. They are dynamic, always on the go, well -built and charmers. They have the ability to phenomenally rise in life no matter what standard of living they possess. They enjoy ever-lasting fame and wealth. They are good in terms of planning, managing money and spend cautiously, even if they have to spend on their own. They are full of courage, will power, self -confidence and have a gift of grab. Their quest for a better life is never ending and during the middle age they reach prominent rank or positions. Opportunities keep coming to them & they grab it with both the hands and make the most of it. Family life is sorted. Example — Ricky Ponting and Shahrukh Khan.
42.businessDescription: An excellent name number for business especially those involved in shipping, export / import, luxury or exclusive articles, precious gemstones, apparels.

43.description: This number is associated with revolution, upheaval and destruction. They have a tendency to develop enemies easily. They are highly imaginative & have tactful speech and writing skills. They switch jobs rather easily. Their family life is far from peaceful. Success is achieved and desires are fulfilled only in the end. They are hypocrites and keep changing their stand. They are known for making controversial statements. They will face more opposition than support but that doesn't deter their action -oriented spirit. Their shrewdness increases with age. It is an unlucky number in the sense that these people do not enjoy comforts of a peaceful life public welfare is something they look forward to but will not be known for it. Example - Adolf Hitler.
43.businessDescription: A good name number only for those engaged in occult. It would give them phenomenal success. For the rest it is an avoid.

44.description: This should be an avoidable number as it has the ability to spoil reputation of people on high posts and authority. This number has the power to make the person extremely materialistic. Money comes in rather easily for such people. It is very important for such people to control their mind and limit their materialistic desires or they wouldn't mind taking an evil path to fulfil their achievements. Taking an evil path may bring them a lot of suffering, shame and pain. The number also indicates likeliness of getting convicted so they should mend their ways. They may have sufferings both mental and physical. They have danger from fire and electricity. Example — Chanda Kochhar.
44.businessDescription: Industries involving people like theatres, iron & steel, coal, manufacturers of sports goods, printing press, Vehicles on hire, bank can have 44 as name number.

45.description: An excellent number to have. They are known for their oratory skills and keep an audience entertained. They have the calibre t o rise to a higher status and position in life. They can run a large business house such is the talent they possess not undermining the hard work they do. They will be role-models for people and their life would be well endowed. They set their goals high and also achieve them. They do face difficulties in life but do not believe in sharing. Any illness if faced by them will be cured easily. They have a pleasant countenance and always retain a smile on their face even with difficulties at hand. They pay a lo t of attention to detail and acquire long lasting wealth.
45.businessDescription: SThis number makes the business shine especially stock markets related businesses say a mutual fund house, an insurance company, bank, trading or commission businesses. Example - Deutsche bank.

46.description: Knowledge, wealth, prudence and intelligence are all the traits inherited by name number 46. If such a person makes optimum use of his abilities can be known internationally. Opinions will be sought and conclusions will be arrived at, on their guidance. They also possess leadership qualities and have the talent to take their business to the top. As they progress in age, so does their fame and money. They have a good family life . Any plan conceived with nobility will get materialized. For them honesty and luck have a direct relationship. The more honest they are, the luckier they get. They will be remembered for their achievements. Appreciation follows wherever they go. They would really well in the field of arts or politics. Example - Mark Zuckerberg.
46.businessDescription: If the business is conducted by using fair means and no foul play is involved, this number has the ability to make the business as a market leader. Example - Honda Motors.

47.description: This number is for expansion and movement. Those people who rise very fast in life have strong chances of having a name number 47. They do not rest until and unless they have accomplished their goal. Quick decision makers, coherent organizers and good comm unicators are some adjectives to describe them. Money flows in abundance. They should abstain from killing or eating flesh. They are likely to suffer from headaches and eyesight issues and in some cases end up losing their eyesight. They should cultivate the habit of taking the divine path which would take those places; any sinful act conducted will have the ability to harm them. They are quick at finding fixes for problems. Example — Sourav Ganguly and Priyanka Chopra 3A go ahead only for businesses which require no capital but the mental skill.

48.description: Number 48 belongs to numerology series 3, these people have fate acting against them. Such people will be found at the wrong place at the wrong time and become victims. They are keenly interested in spiritual sciences and also concerned about the welfare of the people. They would do a lot for the welfare of the public 7 in turn will face wrath for attempting things beyond their capabilities. They earn money and wealth but eventually lose everything as luck doesn't favour them. It's a very karmically influenced number and should be avoided for personal growth. They are interested in pilgrimages.
48.businessDescription: It is not number for worldly success. So, in case of business, it is a BIG no.

49.description: Number 49 people are source of guiding light in the lives of many. They strongly believe in establishing order and balance in life. They accomplish tasks which rarely people can. Their life is the envy of many. They acquire sudden wealth and fame. They hav e eventful live and travel a lot domestically as well as internationally. Life throws a volley of wonderful experiences at them along with prosperity. They own a lot of immovable properties. They can earn a lot of money from business/profession related to arts. They are prone to accidents and also have the danger of being burnt to death. They are known for their heroic deeds. Example — Manmohan Singh.
49.businessDescription: A good name number for business, there may be fallouts in business but that will give experience to run the business more efficiently

50.description: These are extremely intelligent people and possess a high degree of analytical skill. Brilliant conversationalist, experts, excellent speakers and self-confident is what makes a name number 50. They do well in academics. They have sharp mind and are quick decision makers. They can be good educationists. Although they can get involved in any kind of business and would succeed owing to their intelligen ce and hardworking nature. They have special expertise in mathematics, science, law and astrology. They can earn a lot of money from their writing or public speaking. Name number 50 brings perfect luck after the age of 50. Example - Sachin Tendulkar and Sunil Bharti Mittal.
50.businessDescription: It gives the business the power to outshine. The business would flourish and exist for a long time.

51.description: This is the most powerful of all the number under 6. This number signifies sudden stroke of luck and sudden prosperity. They get inflow of money from unexpected sources. They have undying energy and stamina to keep working. They also possess the physical strength and will power to keep moving. They constantly think of ways to enhance their wealth. They can have multiple sources of income. These people tend to have a disturbed sleep due to constant action in mind and body because they work tirelessly. They have an extraordinary energy that governs their body and mind. They have a wide circle of friends and relatives
51.businessDescription: A very good name number to have for business. Such a kind of business would go zooming ahead of its competitors and will make a lot of eyeballs to roll.

52.description: In case of name number 52, mercury (intellect) overpowers the moon (mind). Mind is an observer it is the intellect which helps decide between the good or the bad based on the experience. Name number 52 people have a share intellect, a good insight and highly developed intuitive power. They are dependable friends, good counsellors and will be ready to offer a solution to any problem. If they follow a spiritual path success comes easily to them. These people have the power to change o r known as 'revolutionaries. They have a gift speech and have the ability to convince. Their family life suffers but they will have a good social life, will be famous and liked by all. They are such people who will remember even after death, for the work they do. Example — Lakshmi Niwas Mittal.
52.businessDescription: There will be lots of ups and downs in business so the business growth will be curtailed. A red signal for business.

53.description: They are going — getters, possess the inner strength, stamina and discipline to keep going even when the odds are against. They can be best describe by 'when the going gets tough' they get going. The early part of life will consist of a lot of ups and downs. But as they grow old, lif e tends to normal and becomes steadier. They have a strong desire to be famous. They become famous when they take up social service. They face difficulties which break them but they gather themselves up and get going. Example - Virender Sehwag, Manohar Parrikar and Roger Federer.
53.businessDescription: Saturn will bring a lot of miseries & misfortunes like loss, fire accidents, court cases, tax raids and theft.

54.description: They grow step by step in life; initial life is full advertise but as they grow up life becomes better. These people have material wealth earned through hard work and inheritance. Stubborn, greed and thoughtless can make them lose their hard -earned money. They know how to best utilize their abilities and wealth. They do not wish to part with their earning & have miser tendencies. Their life is a mixed bag comprising of success and failures. They can be good counsellors owing to their captivating speech. Thi s number should be best taken as a name number. Example — Viswanathan Anand, Barack Hussein Obama.
54.businessDescription: Mars pushes rash decisions in business which is not good for the financial health of the company. This number has to be ignored.

55.description: They have a head full of information, are knowledge bearer and intelligent. They face opposition in life but opposition doesn't stand any chance to win in front of them. Apart from victory over enemies, such people have stro ng determination and intuition. They will astonish people with the amount of varied knowledge they possess on all the subjects. They can obtain high degrees and can also be termed as scholars. It depends on them how to make use of the information they have , either constructively or destructively. If they misuse the innate talent they have, it has the power to destroy them. If they make the best use of their knowledge, they can become famous. This number has the power to even cure genetic diseases. Example - Kiran Mazumdar Shaw.
55.businessDescription: A good name number for business. It will make the business a leader in its field.

56.description: 56 belong to moon series of numerology but each number is unique because it is made up of two numbers which have different vibrations. This is a number full of wonders. This number is widely used by people (especially born on 7) who are involved in occultism, divination experts and metaphysical practitioners. Because of the presence of moon, these people have psychic abilities. These people possess high level of intelligence which helps them break free fromany kind of bondage. They have an unsteady life & can lose their wealth and fame all at once. But the pleasures gained temporarily far outnumber the problem brought by unsteadiness.
56.businessDescription: A useful business number for making progress. It confers the business name, fame and wealth.

57.description: Not a good number in num erological series as it signifies defeat in the end. The person may rise to formidable position or status to ultimately fall and face sufferings. Life moves at a very fast pace; the rise & the decline are both sudden and life comes to a standstill. They ar e not able to gather wealth. In spite of knowing what to do, their implementation takes a lot of time. In order to improve their situation, they need to look at the situation closely and act after properly understanding it. If the conflicts in their mind remain unresolved, their life would become monotonous and stagnant.
57.businessDescription: An avoid for business as it would ultimately lead to closure of the establishment.

58.description: The group of planets involved in making number 58 are all friendly with each other so these people have a mass apple & can attract the attention and interest of people. Intellect (mercury) meets labour (Saturn) so these people do they work diligently and progress swiftly in life. They will have a lot of achievements to their name. Due to presence of Saturn, they are narrow minded and reformatory. They are treasure houses of knowledge. To the world these people would appear to be really blessed and lucky but internally they wil l have a lot of fears. They may be forced to do certain thing against their wishes. Example— Khushdeep Bansal.
58.businessDescription: It bestows the business with name and fame. These businesses stay in the public eye for long; their products have a strong recall va lue. Financially the business would grow. Example — Fedex Express.

59.description: These people are researchers, inquisitive and expressive. The urge to express is so strong that they can be great writers, lyrists, p oets and literary men the world. They earn hugely owning to their writing skills. Their writings have a sense of humour. Their fortunes would be permanent. They need to keep a check on their eating habits or it can impact their health adversely. They get a lot of public support. They are guided by ambition and have an urge to earn a lot of money. They gain greatly because of their creativity and talents in performing arts. They have the talent to become public figures. They go up the ladder of success step by step.
59.businessDescription: Money inflow would be really solid for the business. Such businesses have the ability to make a fortune.

60.description: They enjoy a life full of riches and comforts. They are skilled conversationalist who knows how to put an argument forward. They words have a far-reaching impact on people. They can carry out a debate very well. They have a happy and peaceful family life. This number signifies prosperity, growth and wisdom. They are ma terially well endowed. They are humble and have a huge friend circle. They have a pleasing personality and attractive gait. Wisdomand skill is present in plenty. Wealth that they accumulate is due to art or oration. They can have a profession which involves engaging and entertaining people, art related or anything that requires writing or speaking skills. Luck prosperity fame wealth stay all throughout. This is a very fortunate number to have. Example - Navjot Singh Sidhu.
60.businessDescription: A good name number to have. The only caution to be practiced is the person owing the business should not have 3 as the mind number.

61.description: These people are attractive. When moving in the crowd, they are the centre of attraction such is their magnificence and charm. They will attract a lot of people towards themselves. Their way of functioning would be dynamic and inconsistent with the established standards. People would admire them for their above-mentioned qualities. These people can be leaders or speakers in areas of spirituality. They would be the torch bearers for the society & would love to help and serve. They do not expect anything in return. Welfare of the people is more important than their own comfort. Honest in conduct and outspoken by words are the ones possessing 61 as their name number. They cannot tolerate dishonesty in their life.
61.businessDescription: The sacrificial and no reward seeking quality that the number is not suitable for an organization that works for profit.

62.description: Their life is a mix of happiness and sorrows. They have the ability to turn their friends into enemies. They have a disturbed family life and have bad relations with relatives. They are addicte d to vice like liquor, gambling and women. They are tempted by bars, costly restaurants, and casinos. Such people are day dreamers and build castles in the air. They adapt to cheating to make a living for themselves. They want to live a lavish life irrespective of the means available at their disposal. They have a lot of illicit sexual relationship and are therefore subject to sexually transmitted diseases. Example Jennifer Lopez.
62.businessDescription: This is not a good number for business. If the person managing the business does not have a name number as 62, the amount of disappointments will be less.

63.description: This number is made up of the Guru of Gods (Jupiter) & Guru of demon (Venus) and thus means more harm than good. It is not a very viable number as the person will encounter a lot of trials and tribulations in his lifetime. Such people have a neglected childhood and therefore get into evil ways. Their mind is all the time contemplating evil deeds. They are able to master evil forces like black magic, other mystical powers, controlling and ordering spirits. They face a lot of difficulties in life, even when they try to achieve a small thing. These people will make money by hook or crook. Ancient texts describe this number as belonging to thieves or anti - social elements.
63.businessDescription: It is not advisable to have a name number as 63 for business as it will only incur losses and eventually will have to be rectified.

64.description: These people are blessed with sharp intellect, knowledge and strong will power. They have equal number of friends and enemies. Though they face a lot of opposition in life, they manage to emerge out victorious. They are capable of doing things that others find it hard to do and thus have a name in the society. People hold them in high esteemand are well respected in society. High Government positions are what they could be working at. A number like this is more suited to people with whose bi rth number are in sync with the name number. Whatever they say becomes true. Example - Deepika Padukone.

65.description: These people work for public welfare especially for lower segments of society who aren't well provided. They can gather a lot of support from influential people for the social work they do. These influential people also provide support to them in their business and thus help them grow. This number denotes divine grace and spiritual development. Due to the impact of moon, their life is characterised by a lot of ups and downs. These people get into unexpected troubled but sail through by the grace of God. These people will be happy and content in their married life. They may face dangers like accidents, knife wounds and bullet injuries. Example - Pervez Musharaf.
65.businessDescription: Business would be characterized by ups and downs. There would not be much growth in business. Example - Standard Chartered Bank.

66.description: This is one of the best numbers in numerology number 3 series as it has a double influence of Venus (passion) which weakens the very core of the number Jupiter (virtues). This number is really good for mate rial growth. This name numbers shouts accomplishments on all the fronts — professional, emotional, physical and financial. So, in the case of name number 66 the person will find favour in all the Venus related things like arts, successful relationships, po wer, high ranks in defence and an extravagant lifestyle. These people have excellent oration skills and can sweep the audience off their feet. The presence of Jupiter helps in assessing the situation and help in differentiate between the good and the bad. Example - Mahendra Singh Dhoni.
66.businessDescription: The enmity between Jupiter & Venus but it is somewhat mitigated by the dual presence of Venus. A number such as this can be used for business but not by people having mind number as 8. Example - Johnson & Johnson

67.description: This number is made up of creativity (Venus) and psychic (Ketu). These people are exceptional artists and make money by way of it. They are hard —working people who have the ability to work tirelessly and thus earn a lot of names 7 fame. These people can make a good name in the field of theatre, dance, music, mimicry, film making. With the kind of work they do, they get a lot of female attention but they should maintain their distance or it can harm t hem. People with such number are have a spiritual bent of mind too, they can also earn through writing books on spirituality or conducting spiritual discourses. If they become selfish in life, they will not achieve anything.
67.businessDescription: A name number which can be used by business publishing book on religion, spirituality, manufacturers of fancy items and woman related businesses

68.description: This number brings in a lot of failure, can be rarely lucky for some. Venus is the plus in the number Saturn is the minus Mercury deviates in between in between the two, giving them both kind of experience, pleasurable and painful. They get into tasks they cannot complete and the sufferings follows. Their greed to make money spoils their career and life. They always remain dissatisfied with their life. The feeling of permanence is missing in their life. But they are on the go all the time, always involved in something or the other. State of finance is chaotic but they have enough meant to make ends meet. They can do business related to iron, heavy machinery and Vehicles.
68.businessDescription: A number like this can lead to closure or bankruptcy of the business. Such a business would start on a good note but eventually will give only losses.

69.description: Venus and Mars together in the name number promises success in all the endeavours. Slow but steady development is what describes their life at best. They are persistent in their eff orts and thus achieve success. They do not require any assistance; they alone are sufficient to manage their tasks. They have a majestic appearance. They have certain royalty about their speech and actions. They depend on tried and tested ways of doing a t ask. These people have a good family life. Friends may of the same status or even higher. They enjoy collecting artwork and spend freely on art.
69.businessDescription: A green signal for this one as this promises robust profits.

70.description: The dual aspect of 7 in the 70 intensifies its effect in the number. These people will have a lot of interest in spirituality and matters related to God. Presence of zero in the number signifies infinity. Such a number has the power to go to the depths of spirituality. They earn fame abroad owing to spirituality. These people possess a lot of wisdomand are full of nobility. Faith in the divine helps 70 sail through life. They life a very simple life and are not driven by money. Love, relationships don't hold a place in your life. Family life is rather depressive, their either marry late or don't marry at all.
70.businessDescription: Not a good name for business, as it isn't driven by material success. The business with 70 as name number will have initial stroke of luck but will later produce dissatisfied customers.

71.description: Not a very fortunate number to have as a name number. Those people are confused and under confident. They cannot be relied upon for advice because they lack clarity. But over the years these people garner knowledge (ketu) and leadership qualities (Sun). A person can use the above skill for public good. These people need to understand that there will initial years of suffering wherein their decisions will go wrong and emotional disturbances. Eventually things will automatically start falling in place in the later stage of life but damage caused by initial years cannot be made good so such a number should be better avoided. Financial front would be miserable too.
71.businessDescription: Not a good name for business. 7 number in 71 will make you lose money and incompetence in handling the customer. Such business would face labour unrest, lockouts, strikes and raids also.

72.description: Slow 7 steady wins the race best describes name number 72. They might suffer in initial years of life but the wealth they amass therefore though slowly stay with them for the rest of their life. They enjoy a luxurious lifestyle. The middle age kick starts the desirable lifestyle for them. Wealth acquired is so much that future generations of the native enjoy it as well. They deploy all their talents to work. Ketu in the number gives tremendous knowledge & intuition to do anything and moon gives creative imagination Though Mars is inimical to both Ketu and Moon but Mars is unable to show its enmity due to friendship between 2 and 7 so Mars lets them act freely. Mars gives extraordinary skills to face hurdles coming in the way. Mars makes sure that the task they take up gets completed with success.
72.businessDescription: One of the best numbers for business. Number 72 in business does really well. These businesses make huge profits. For them money inflows like water. The business reaches heights & has the ability to be known all over the world. The wealth generated by such businesses can be enjoyed by generations to come.

73.description: These people have highly developed mental faculties, intuition, psychic powers and knowledge. They are an excellent mix of worldly wisdomand divine knowledge. Such a number bestows name, fame, fortune and power to the person. They people can head higher positions, especially in the government related departments. These people enjoy support of influential people. They can have multiple sources of income. Material possessions are in plenty. They can be good leaders. These people enjoy all sorts of worldly pleasures. It is very important for p eople with name number 73 to be honest and keep their integrity intact; else they can lose their money and reputation. Such people are devoted to God and spiritual. If they take up evil ways, failure is certain.
73.businessDescription: In case a business has this name, it has to ensure honesty and fair play in all its dealing otherwise it would do them more harm than good.

74.description: Rahu & Ketu both influence this number and they are poles apart. Ketu makes on e deeply religious, spiritual and Rahu breaks all conventional methods and wants to take up the most unconventional route. This number for self-destruction because their own actions become the reason for their downfall. 7 & 4 are already treading on differ ent paths with one preaching religion and other preaching against the usual. To add to it, moon which adds to fickle mindedness, it is a number full of chaos. They worry more than what the situation warrants. Regretting the past and anxious about the future, they spoil their present. Finances are in bad shape, family life is troubled, and healthissues keep bothering. Not a good name numerology number to have expected for hermits and priests.
74.businessDescription: A complete avoids name number for business.

75.description: Number 75 confirms academic excellence in school, matters of religion, philosophy and art. They are extremely creative and exhibit talents as an author, poet, lyricist, speakers or writer. These people lag behind others. They are not interested in home affairs or marriage. They can delay their marriage or even if they get married, they lose interest. They get sudden name and fame. Friendships they make are rock -solid. They are loner at times. People take the ir part of the credit. They possess a lot of wisdom; people round them take advantage of it to solve their issues. They are driven by their vision and become famous.

76.description: Those having name number 76 lose all their worldly possession at some point of time in life. Ketu dominates the number as it starts from 7 these people have less inclination to make money. Though they are financially, academically and professionally settled, they have a distorted married life and prefer living in solitude. The last years of life are spent in solitude but the rest of the life is well spent working with a spirit of keep going. This number suits people who wish to selflessly work for the upliftment of others. These p eople would earn a lot of name, fame and divine grace if they carry such selfless service.
76.businessDescription: A business with name number 76 would exist for some time but would cease to exist owing to mistakes, bad clients and cheating. The loss bourn is irrecoverable even if different techniques are deployed.

77.description: 77 is a good number that confers profits, fame, luck, self-confidence and honour. Since 7 has the aspect of two 7's this confers divine blessings on them. If they take the divine path, life would be full of happiness with all luxuries. They have a lot of foreign travel. A task accomplished and they get on with the next task with lot of enthusiasm. Good characters, God fearing, well respected are some of their traits. They get a lot of support from others but they take pride in being self-made. If they take the right path in life, they will have a good married life country to the belief what ketu gives.
77.businessDescription: Business with name number 77 have God's divine hand in running the affairs. God showers his love and blessings to the business in terms of growth and profits

78.description: 78 is another great number From Venus's stable. 7 followed by 8 and leading to 6 is what makes this number brilliant. A better way to understand this is a good son born to poor parents has the ability to make them rich. Caring, charitable and nurturing without an expectation of rewards is what makes up 78. They do not run after money but money in abundance comes to them automatically. This number would make a person religious but also orthodox. Venus in this retains all its virtues. They are dependable friends. In spite of hurdles, they face due to Saturn they are able to overcome them. These people can be good poets, have excellent oratory skills and an ability to cast a spell on other. Such qualities enable them to motivate people. They are not just good at preaching but also implementing what they so preach.
78.businessDescription: Such businesses would rise without much of an effort. A go ahead to this one.

79.description: These people face a lot of stumbling blocks in early part of life. Whatever they try to do is met with failure. They have a poor childhood. But they rise very quickly later in life due to their never say die spirit and cleverness. The knowledge and experience they garner in early part of life helps in charting out a successful path due to any failures. Family life is little unstable but they would be of great help to those who depend on them. They get immense support which helps them lead a comfortable and successful life. Their fortunes shine with the passage of time and they become great personalities.
79.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits.

80.description: Saturn in the number gives misfortunes, sorrows, sufferings and miseries. Since the beginning of life, the person will face hardship in relation to education and day to day living. Ill -health would be a prominent feature for number 80 people; they can also get some undiaganosable diseases. This number has a tendency to give criminal instincts and can make t hem thieves, rapist or terrorists. They do possess some mystic powers. They have good stamina and power to endure but it is of no use as fate is against them. Professional and personal lives are deeply affected. Though they slog hard to make ends meet but they aren't successful. They should be careful of accidents.
80.businessDescription: Such a business is doomed to fail. It is a complete avoid.

81.description: This is a fortunate number. These people will have a blessed personal and professional life. They enjoy wealth, name, fame and all the luxuries of life. They will have a lot of prosperities to their name. Sun & Mars together increase the fire element in the number, sun being dominating and mars being arrogant invites a lot of je alousy from people. These would attract unnecessary hatred & malice from people and would leave no stone unturned to bring disgrace to the person. Basically, these people have lot of enemies which can cause them great deal of harm. They should be very careful in life else their luck would change for the worse. These people should be careful of accidents.
81.businessDescription: A risky name for business as there would be lot of eyes on the business to bring it down.

82.description: It's a highly powerful number and it can elevate an ordinary person to extraordinary heights. These people can rule the society and will have many followers. They have magnetic powers about them which attract people. Those having 82 as their name number are very conscious of their duties and responsibilities. They are well endowed with land, good mines, precious gemstones and vehicles. They can make a fortune if they put their stakes in horse racing, car racing or any other sport. Theyface un necessary issues in their love life due to their own adamant nature. They dominate the scene wherever they go. If they indulge in liquor, they would face disappointments, delays and defeats. These people should be wary of accidents.
82.businessDescription: This number can be used as a business number after checking the compatibility with the mind number

83.description: This number blesses one with sharp intellect, hard work and dedication. This number promises prestigious positions in life like that of a bureaucrat, leader or a judge. Society looks upon such people with respect and admiration. The life of a person would that be of a king and they would carry it with self -confidence. These people will be very successful. 83 also warns that the success you enjoy can crumble one day in your later years of life if the person's conduct is not proper as Saturn is a judge it would only give that much what the person deserves. These people will be deceived at the hands of their friends and relatives.
83.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits.

84.description: Their childhood will be miserable and full of struggle. Poor household, poor academics, unrecognition of talent are some of the problems which would be faced by the holder of the name. This in turn would make them jealous, insecure, and bad tempered. They have the ability to catch incurable diseases in early life. Delays and disappointments would be present throughout their lifetime. They would invite unnecessary enemies on account of ill deeds. They would invite unnecessary enemies on account of ill deeds. They have a tendency to pick up evil ways due to their distraught life. They would always have a feeling of dejection; rewards would always be less than the effort. These people are wanderers with no specific destination to reach. Spirituality can help them find their lost ground.
84.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits.

85.description: These are the people who attain their goals learning things the hard way. Life is not smooth for them; they face a lot of hardships. Only after continuous and repeated efforts do these people get results. But the profits are far less than the effort put which leads to disappointments. But that does not deter these people to help others. They add to good deeds to their Karmic account by helping others despite the troubles in their life. This enables them rise spiritually. These people would do really well in the field of medicines. Due to their extraordinary bent towards the welfare of people, these attain a position of distinction and honour. They will be respected and loved by all.
85.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits.

86.description: These people also face hardships & obstacles but due to the presence of Venus they climb up the ladder gradually and get what they deserve. Venus gives the motivation to keep going and Mercury gives the persistence. These people get lot of favours from the elite which help them grow and lead a successful life of comforts. Such people lead a simple life and remain humble. Problems in their life don't break them because they have support coming from all sides. They will have all the basic necessities of life and will also have the quality of saving for the future.
86.businessDescription: Initial years of business will be struggle some but eventually the business would pick up steam.

87.description: There is a world of a difference between 78 and 87 as here takes the command. Money that these people would earn would earn would earn would be through devious means like womanising, gambling, activities of criminal nature. Such people can b e criminals, drug peddlers, terrorists or extortionist. Due to the presence of 7, these people would have mystical powers which would enable them to charm snakes, tame animals and dupe people? They would commit crimes without realizing what they are doing. This should be a complete avoid.
87.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits

88.description: This number is good for a person who intend s to make spiritual progress on other fronts this numbers does lot of damages. It is bad number for family life. Materially this number does not give any success. Such people do not like being around people they are loners. Wealth does not entice these peo ple. Nature wise these people are generous and philosophical. They spend a lot of time reading books on religion and spirituality. Even if they earn money, they would lend it to other people and not enjoy it themselves. They earn them admiration of people for their generosity and compassion
88.businessDescription: Good for spiritual organizations or religious organizations, for all others there are better numbers

89.description: This number invites troubles initially but in the long run benefit the one possessing the name number. Childhood life is miserable. In spite of not being well provided, these people do well in studies and develop a talent which makes them outshine others. Hard work put in by these people is rewarded. Due to the sheer persistence & hard work these people rise in life, acquire machinery, land and houses. They lead a fearless life and climb the success ladder sooner than their peers. These people would attract enmity at workplace. They would make all possible efforts for ousting out the person. They face a danger of fire accidents. Married life is also satisfactory.
89.businessDescription: Risky number to have in business because their will mounting tension all the time.

90.description: Such a person will attain success due to being skilful and hardworking. These people would go to any extent to fulfil their desires. The kinds of people falling under 90 are those who don't even get affected by obstacles, they would just kee p going and are unstoppable. These people gave excessive energy levels to keep working and may have multiple sources of income. A perfect 90 would have money flowing from all directions. People who wish to advance spiritually should best avoid this number as this gives only riches. Such people are proud and egoistic.
90.businessDescription: An ideal name number for business as the business would grow by leaps and bounds. A go ahead to this one.

91.description: Such people will have strong determination and possess good technical skills. Leadership qualities will be in plenty and can be heading top most positions in corporate or government sector. They are carrier driven people who would not stop unless and until they achieve their go al. They would undertake a lot of journeys for work or otherwise. Export/import business is well suited for these people. These people will not be attached to wealth and they would like going on pilgrimages. A life full of comforts is what they have. Yoga and meditation can also bring these people success.
91.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits

92.description: Contribute planet — Mars & Moon The number is charismatic and spiritual. People with this number treasure relationship be it on the basis of humanity or team. They can be good teachers on subjects related to philosophy, yoga and human welfare. These people are also intuitive. They find happiness by se rving others. If these people continuously practice yoga techniques, they can acquire the power to defy gravity or defy disease and death.
92.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits.

93.description: These people have the ability to rise to the top and do marvellous things. Impossible is not a word in their dictionary. They improve their worldly knowledge and fulfil their desires. These people can shine in any field be it law, Medicine, Science, Navy a nd Air force. People look upon them for advice. They are multitalented people and can earn through many businesses even arts or drama. Multiple sources of income would surely be there. They have good writing skills as well.
93.businessDescription: An appropriate name number for business. The business would continuously expand and increase its earning.

94.description: Rahu gives the person an astonishing speech and Mars makes the person daring. These people spend early part of life in acquiring education and in the later years they learn to apply it. These people can rise up in life, to higher positions. Once the professional life is on track and moving, they would tend to shift their focus on humanitarian activities. T hey would want to bring about reforms. These people would get support from likeminded people and they would work together for common good of the society. They will be remembered for their good work always. Selflessly they would work for the betterment of the society.
94.businessDescription: In the short term the business would reap supernormal profits & eventually would tend to its mean and earn normal profits .

95.description: These people would be successful in their in their professional life and achieve distinction. With the presence of Mercury twice in the number, they have the business skill. They have brilliant oratory skills and would have a name in their line of business. These people are much disciplined and are perfectionists. Mercury gives them the ability to think out of box. They are risk takers when it comes to business but they take calculative risk because of the presence of Mercury. They amass huge wealth but having multiple businesses.
95.businessDescription: With Mercury's impact twice in the number can be business fail
