96.description: A highly lucky number to have as a name number. These people have outstanding educational qualifications. They are rank holders or even those get scholarships. These people have a charming personality and attractive complexion. They have good control over their subordinates. They dictated terms in their relationships. Women get enchanted by them. They can do well in the field of arts , or as an army officer or a captain in the navy. They lead a prosperous and fulfilled life. They are well endowed with property, gemstones and jewellery. They have a good family life.
96.businessDescription: Such a number can be used as a business name number.

97.description: People governed by this number take wrong decisions which can probably harm their future. They depend on wrong people and ultimately spoil their chances of success. Half the things in their life are spoilt by their own decisions. They may face court cases and imprisonments. These people can have a career in spirituality. They can prosper in the field of spirituality and can reap huge benefits.
97.businessDescription: This number would bring a lot of obstacles in business. There will be problem of finance, bad customer base and low profits. Efforts would go waste. The results would not come in early. In short it would be a flop show.

98.description: These people would be very intelligent but they would not be able to make use of this intelligence to solve their own problems and would get into complicated issues. The same knowledge that they possess would come in very handy when it comes to handing problems of people. Their life is full of hassles and they would find it difficult to make ends meet. They would face crisis after crisis. These people would not get respect at work place. They would not be appreciated for the work they do. They would have an accidentprone life and can be affected due to chronic diseases.
98.businessDescription: This is unlucky number for business. It would hamper the ability of business to make continuous profits.

99.description: This number has three -fold power of Mars. Early life will give good education. A person would be a bully in school. Such an influence of mars would push him into devious ways. There would be crazy desire to achieve your ambitions. Desires would be very high. These people would take up criminal ways rather naturally so much would be the desire for money that they would do anything to earn it. Unwanted aggression will be used to get things done. They would resort to violence to achieve their desires. Though they will have wealth and prosperity but the mean s of making it would be improper.
99.businessDescription: The business running under this name number will make unprecedented success. The only care that needs to be taken is it compatibility with the mind number.

100.description: Sun would give initiative, intelligence and drive to succeed but the opportunities that come their way, owing to two zeros', wouldn't be in plenty thus wasted talent. They wealth and prosperity would not be a concern ever in life. These people w ill have a long and comfortable life without many achievements. But in later stage they would take up the divine path for the search of the ultimate truth.
100.businessDescription: Since there would dearth of opportunities, this number will be given a miss.

101.description: These people would garner sufficient help from the government or people of authority. Their own efforts wouldn't be many ups and downs in business will be common. Obstacles in business would be common as well. Not a very good number to have a name number.
101.businessDescription: A business characterized by ups and downs can never grow.

102.description: Unlucky number to have as a name number. It would give initial bouts of success followed by failures and struggles later. This number is better to avoided.

103.description: This number can be considered as a good name number. The material aspect of life would be average initially and later years of life this aspect would get enhanced by way of new sources of income or a complete change in the existing occupational profile. Competition that these people would face will be immense. But the later years of life will be smooth and comfortable.
103.businessDescription: An average number for business name. This should only be chosen when there is no other option and that too after checking compatibility with the mind number.

104.description: This number will bring success in unconventional ways. These people will achieve fame in life but not money. In other words, they will become famous but the fame will not be accompanied by any material gain. So, this is not a number fortunate for those looking for material success.
104.businessDescription: When there are no profits in business there is no fun of running it. A business only functions for a reward.

105.description: This number can be good for material success. It will give good fortune, wealth, name, fame and good environment to live in. But these people would not be living with their family. They would not have good offerings.

106.description: These will be dramatic changes in their life throughout. They face mid -life crisis and face a lot of problems. Later years of life would be comfortable for them. They would get into big problems which won't have an easy solution. These people would just have greed for worldly pursuits and would have absolutely no interest in seeking the divine.
106.businessDescription: It cannot be used as a business name.

107.description: This number has the ability to bring in success for the native. These people would face problems with the opposite sex. Men will face problems from women and women would face problems from men. Even if these people achieve wealth, they won't be able to enj oy it. They will have a far from comfortable life. However, they will be famous and influential.
107.businessDescription: Not recommended for a successful business.

108.description: This number can give the native high positions and successful life. All of their desires will be fulfilled. People with such a number will continuously strive to make progress in life which would give them wealth. A lucky number to have as far as material endowment is concerned.
108.businessDescription: Thumbs up for this one. 108 is a very auspicious number.
